title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary: Normalized imported semio/ui scene assets to replace embedded mesh, line, and point colors with homogeneous scene materials, then recolor them through shared interaction/status state. Extended the existing semio/ui index.tsx tests to cover material replacement and recoloring. Verified the new scene tests pass; the full semio/ui suite still has a pre-existing Rust cargo dependency conflict in ExportDesignModel.
